methodology.sdk_units: milliseconds per operation (a Promise.all group for concurrency cases)
methodology.collector_profile: cargo run (debug), SQLite WAL, HTTP loopback; 3 x 1000 spans per batch size
methodology.transport: SDK microbenchmarks use an in-process acknowledged fetch stub. Collector timings use real HTTP and SQLite.
methodology.caution: Microbenchmark results vary with warmup, scheduling, tracing buffer pressure, and machine load. No production throughput guarantee.
